policy: Italic/reminder horizontal ink and measured advances only, with released font size, bounds and spacing rules. Full native face renders and frozen scans; every factor-1 raster and score must equal the release. No capture submitted to the app.
decision: Retain the released italic width. A 2% reduction has a small average gain but introduces 21 whole-card regressions exceeding one point; it does not transfer reliably. All 156 baseline native raster hashes and whole-card scores matched the released browser; no scan pose or coverage changed. No production renderer change.
